title: Browser logs contain debug messages
proposed_test_method: Render an approved representative URL set in an instrumented headless browser and capture console events without submitting forms.
exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, browser version, timestamp, console level, message hash, source URL and line; redact values matching secret patterns.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when a production page emits debug/error console events matching the approved debug or sensitive-disclosure policy; require repeatability on two loads.
notes: Page coverage must be declared; do not infer SSC collection scope.

title: Server with Expired Certificate Contacted
proposed_test_method: Render approved pages, inventory contacted HTTPS origins, and use a direct TLS handshake only for separately authorized dependencies; use approved passive certificate evidence for out-of-scope origins.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Parent page URL, dependency origin, browser TLS error, certificate chain hash, notAfter, validation time, scope decision and passive-source provenance when used.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding only when the browser contacted the origin and either an authorized handshake or fresh authoritative passive certificate record proves notAfter earlier than observation time; otherwise indeterminate.
required_external_data: Approved dependency scope plus passive certificate/CT evidence for out-of-scope origins
notes: Browser dependency discovery is direct, but proving expiry may require data for a third-party origin that the scanner is not authorized to probe.

title: Server certificate issued by country on denylist
proposed_test_method: Build the validated certificate chain, identify issuing CA legal jurisdiction from an approved CA registry, and evaluate an organization-maintained denylist.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Chain DER hashes, issuer identity, registry provenance/version, jurisdiction and policy-list version.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding only when the validated issuer jurisdiction is explicitly present in the current internal denylist; unknown jurisdiction is indeterminate.
required_external_data: CA ownership/jurisdiction registry and internal sanctions policy
notes: Certificate subject country alone is not reliable issuer jurisdiction.

title: Non-standard links detected: Contact information displayed
proposed_test_method: Crawl only approved same-origin pages and parse anchor/DOM URI schemes associated with contact details.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Page URL, element type, URI scheme and a redacted/hash-only contact value.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when href uses an internal-policy contact scheme (for example mailto, tel, sms, whatsapp or viber); never store the clear contact value.
notes: Presence is an exposure observation, not proof of social-engineering risk.

title: Session Cookie Missing 'HttpOnly' Attribute
proposed_test_method: Collect Set-Cookie headers during an approved synthetic authentication flow and identify session cookies from a reviewed cookie inventory/purpose map; never retain values.
exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, response status, hashed cookie name, authenticated-flow step, session-cookie classification provenance and boolean HttpOnly attribute; value discarded.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when a cookie established as a session/authentication cookie lacks HttpOnly; an unclassified cookie is indeterminate rather than a finding.
required_external_data: Approved synthetic authentication flow and versioned session-cookie inventory/classification
notes: The attribute is externally visible, but session purpose is not reliably inferable from a cookie name or an unauthenticated response.

title: Session Cookie Missing 'Secure' Attribute
proposed_test_method: Collect Set-Cookie headers during an approved synthetic authentication flow and identify session cookies from a reviewed cookie inventory/purpose map; never retain values.
exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, response status, hashed cookie name, authenticated-flow step, session-cookie classification provenance and boolean Secure attribute; value discarded.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when a cookie established as a session/authentication cookie lacks Secure; an unclassified cookie is indeterminate rather than a finding.
required_external_data: Approved synthetic authentication flow and versioned session-cookie inventory/classification
notes: The attribute is externally visible, but session purpose is not reliably inferable from a cookie name or an unauthenticated response.

title: Content Security Policy (CSP) Missing
proposed_test_method: Fetch approved HTML pages, collect all CSP headers/meta policies, parse directives according to CSP3, and evaluate the effective policy.
exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, delivery channel, parsed directives, duplicate-policy handling, nonce/hash presence and policy text hash.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when neither an enforced Content-Security-Policy response header nor valid CSP meta policy is present on an HTML document; report-only alone does not satisfy.
notes: No attempt is made to infer SSC thresholds.

title: Content Security Policy Contains Broad Directives
proposed_test_method: Fetch approved HTML pages, collect all CSP headers/meta policies, parse directives according to CSP3, and evaluate the effective policy.
exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, delivery channel, parsed directives, duplicate-policy handling, nonce/hash presence and policy text hash.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when effective script-src/object-src/default-src permits wildcard, unscoped scheme sources, data: for active content, or another internal-policy broad source.
notes: No attempt is made to infer SSC thresholds.

title: Content Security Policy Contains 'unsafe-*' Directive
proposed_test_method: Fetch approved HTML pages, collect all CSP headers/meta policies, parse directives according to CSP3, and evaluate the effective policy.
exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, delivery channel, parsed directives, duplicate-policy handling, nonce/hash presence and policy text hash.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when effective active-content directives contain 'unsafe-eval', 'unsafe-inline' without nonce/hash controls, or another explicitly disallowed unsafe token.
notes: No attempt is made to infer SSC thresholds.

title: Site does not enforce HTTPS
proposed_test_method: Probe approved HTTP and HTTPS endpoints and follow only bounded same-target redirects.
exact_observation_or_evidence: HTTP/HTTPS reachability, redirect hops, final scheme, TLS validation result and tested port/path set.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when HTTP serves content without a permanent upgrade to valid HTTPS, or an approved canonical endpoint remains reachable only by HTTP.
notes: Current executor tests root on configured ports but not declared application paths, so support is partial.

title: Domain Uses HSTS Preloading
proposed_test_method: Validate preload-eligible HSTS policy and test the registrable domain against a versioned Chromium HSTS preload dataset.
exact_observation_or_evidence: HSTS directives, HTTPS validity, preload-list revision/hash and exact matched domain entry.
proposed_rule_logic: Positive observation only when policy has max-age>=31536000, includeSubDomains and preload, and the domain is present in the pinned preload list; otherwise report precise unmet conditions.
notes: List membership is time-dependent; persist dataset version.

title: Potentially Exposed Cisco Web UI
proposed_test_method: Fingerprint Cisco IOS XE Web UI without authentication and correlate exact release evidence to Cisco advisories for CVE-2023-20198/CVE-2023-20273.
exact_observation_or_evidence: HTTP/TLS fingerprint, product/release evidence, advisory revisions and match confidence.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding only when the Web UI is exposed and a confirmed affected release is identified; exposure with hidden version is indeterminate, not vulnerable.
required_external_data: Cisco advisory and NVD CVE records
notes: No authentication bypass or implant checks.

title: Site fails to load page components
proposed_test_method: Render approved pages with a headless browser and capture failed subresource requests after a bounded network-idle window.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Page URL, resource URL/origin, resource type, failure reason, HTTP status and initiator; query values redacted.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when required script/style/font/image/XHR resources repeatedly fail due to DNS, TLS, network, CSP or HTTP error; ignore explicitly optional/cancelled resources by policy.
notes: Requires a declared page set and stability threshold.

title: Website Hosted on Object Storage
proposed_test_method: Resolve and inspect the site origin; match DNS aliases, TLS identities and HTTP signatures against a versioned cloud object-storage provider catalog.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Observed hostname/CNAME, certificate SAN/issuer, provider signature, HTTP headers and provider-catalog version.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when at least two independent indicators identify the site origin as object storage; a hostname suffix alone is insufficient.
notes: Provider catalog must be reviewed and versioned.

title: Website Does Not Implement HSTS Best Practices
proposed_test_method: Fetch HTTPS responses and parse Strict-Transport-Security according to RFC 6797 across approved canonical hosts.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Header values, parse result, max-age, includeSubDomains, preload token, response scheme and host.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when HSTS is absent on HTTPS, invalid/duplicated, max-age below internal minimum, or required includeSubDomains is absent; never honor HSTS received over HTTP.
notes: Current executor records only presence, not policy correctness.

title: Non-standard links detected: Unsafe File Transfer Protocol
proposed_test_method: Crawl bounded approved same-origin HTML and parse navigable/resource URLs after standards-based URL resolution.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Source page, element/attribute, resolved destination scheme and redacted destination host/path hash.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when a rendered/static DOM URL uses the ftp: scheme in a context covered by internal policy; do not follow non-HTTP destinations.
notes: Observation is deterministic for the declared crawl; it does not imply SSC crawl equivalence.

title: Insecure HTTPS Redirect Pattern

exact_observation_or_evidence: Every hop's URL scheme/host/port/status and Location scheme, plus stop reason.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when HTTPS downgrades to HTTP, redirects oscillate schemes, or HTTP reaches content before upgrade, under the approved redirect policy.
notes: No external redirects are fetched unless separately authorized.

exact_observation_or_evidence: Port, certificate fingerprint, key algorithm, RSA/DSA bit length or EC curve, policy version and observation time.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when the leaf key is below the policy minimum or uses a disallowed algorithm; unknown key types are indeterminate.
notes: The current TLS executor records public key bits but not the complete algorithm/curve evidence contract.

title: Redirect Chain Contains HTTP
proposed_test_method: Issue bounded HEAD/GET requests and resolve Location fields per HTTP semantics while enforcing inventory scope.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Every hop's URL scheme/host/port/status and Location scheme, plus stop reason.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when any hop after an HTTPS request, or any Location emitted by an HTTPS hop, resolves to http:.
notes: The executor records sufficient redirect evidence, but no active rule is linked to this SSC_API issue; support remains partial until the specific condition is evaluated.

title: Link redirects to insecure website
proposed_test_method: Extract links from approved pages, resolve bounded redirect chains only within approved scope, and use an approved passive redirect/URL service for out-of-scope destinations.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Source page and link, every authorized hop's scheme/host/port/status and Location, passive-source provenance for external hops, and stop reason.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when the evidenced terminal destination is HTTP; an unprobed out-of-scope redirect is indeterminate rather than insecure by assumption.
required_external_data: Approved redirect-target scope or passive redirect intelligence for out-of-scope destinations
notes: A Location header to an external URL proves only the next hop, not the terminal insecure destination.

title: Insecure channel exposes sensitive information

exact_observation_or_evidence: Page/request URL, transport scheme, flow step, policy data class, schema provenance, request method and synthetic-marker match; real values never stored.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when a field established as sensitive by policy/schema or a synthetic sensitive marker is transmitted over HTTP/ws or to an insecure destination.
required_external_data: Approved test flow plus versioned sensitive-data schema/classification policy
notes: Field names and input types alone are proxy signals and cannot reliably establish that observed data is sensitive.

exact_observation_or_evidence: URL, method, status, retry result, response-header hash and timestamp; body omitted except approved diagnostic signature hashes.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when a URL reproducibly returns 5xx (excluding policy-approved maintenance) on two bounded attempts.
notes: Current executor observes only one representative root response.

proposed_rule_logic: Finding when an HTTPS page initiates any policy-covered request over HTTP or ws; report browser-blocked requests separately.
notes: Do not send form submissions or mutate application state.

title: Unsafe Implementation Of Subresource Integrity
proposed_test_method: Parse external script/stylesheet elements, fetch only approved public resources, and validate integrity metadata using the SRI algorithm.
exact_observation_or_evidence: Page/resource URL, crossorigin mode, integrity algorithms/digests, fetch result and recomputed-digest match; resource content not retained.
proposed_rule_logic: Finding when policy-required cross-origin active resources lack SRI, use disallowed algorithms, have invalid metadata, or digest verification fails.
notes: Bound resource size and origins; no execution required.

proposed_rule_logic: Positive only when at least two provider/product indicators agree; otherwise indeterminate.

title: Web Application Firewall (WAF) Detected

authoritative_reference: Vendor WAF documentation per detected product

title: Website defaced

notes: Use synthetic markers; no fuzzing, authentication attacks or collection of user content.

title: Websocket requests contain sensitive fields or PII

required_external_data: Approved test flow plus versioned PII/sensitive-field schema

notes: Browser execution is necessary but does not establish data sensitivity without application-specific context.

title: Insufficient DKIM Key Length
